effects.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

effects.label: Confuse Ray

cards.flavor_text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

effects.label: Hydro Pump
effects.text: 40+ · Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

cards.flavor_text: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cards.flavor_text: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

cards.flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.
